```yaml
name: Update Compat Table Dependency

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Weekly on Monday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-compat-table:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Fetch latest SHA from compat-table
        id: fetch_latest_sha
        run: |
          curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/compat-table/compat-table/commits/main | jq -r '.sha'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Compare SHAs
        id: compare_shas
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(jq -r '.version' tasks/compat_data/package.json)
          LATEST_SHA=${{ steps.fetch_latest_sha.outputs.sha }}
          if [ "$CURRENT_SHA" != "$LATEST_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::set-output name=update_required::true"
            echo "::set-output name=new_sha::$LATEST_SHA"
          else
            echo "::set-output name=update_required::false"
          fi

      - name: Update package.json if necessary
        if: steps.compare_shas.outputs.update_required == 'true'
        run: |
          sed -i '' "s|\"version\": \"[^\"]*\"|\"version\": \"$${steps.compare_shas.outputs.new_sha}\"|" tasks/compat_data/package.json

      - name: Run build process
        if: steps.compare_shas.outputs.update_required == 'true'
        run: pnpm run init && pnpm run build

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.compare_shas.outputs.update_required == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add tasks/compat_data/package.json
          git commit -m "chore: update compat-table to ${steps.compare_shas.outputs.new_sha}"
          git push origin main

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.compare_shas.outputs.update_required == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title: "chore: update compat-table to latest commit"
          body: "chore: update compat-table to ${steps.compare_shas.outputs.new_sha}\n\nThis PR updates the compat-table dependency to the latest commit."
          branch: update-compat-table
          labels: "chore"
          assignees: "Boshen"
```
